match_note: Referees cite content present in arXiv v1: the Fig. 1c PFM hysteresis loop, the +(-)0.2 V holding potential, the 11/38/100 meV modes, Abinit DFT, the 'quantised angular momentum' and 'chiral symmetries' sentences, and the J·q helicity definition. v1 carries the earlier title 'Electric field switching of chiral phonons'; the published title was adopted from Referee 2's second-round suggestion. v1 has no supplementary file, so SI-specific points (Supp. Fig. 5, S3.4) cannot be checked directly.

concerns.quote: Can the Authors show the Dichroism in XAS? This would make an important point in either case (observed or not).
concerns.summary: Asks whether circular dichroism is also present in the X-ray absorption spectrum.

concerns.quote: Besides the phonons, are the Authors detecting any other CD in the RIXS spectra (at high energy)?
concerns.summary: Asks whether dichroism appears in other parts of the RIXS spectrum, at higher energy loss.
concerns.response: addressed with new data or analysis

concerns.quote: what is the temperature of the measurements? Did the Authors collected multiple temperature?
concerns.summary: Measurement temperature is not stated and no temperature dependence is shown.

concerns.quote: What is the physical size in pixels (points) of the instrumental resolution? it would be important to understand more on the effect of the binning on the data.
concerns.summary: The effect of detector binning on resolution and error propagation needs to be explained.

concerns.quote: I would like to see the RIXS spectra on top of each other for C+ and C- to assess the difference? Can the Authors show these for all the momenta collected?
concerns.summary: Raw C+ and C- spectra should be overlaid for every measured momentum so the dichroism can be judged directly.

concerns.quote: The Authors show only one incident energy? is the CD present only at this energy?
concerns.summary: Only one incident photon energy is shown; it is unclear whether the dichroism persists at other energies.

concerns.quote: The dichroism observed in Supp. Fig. 5 seems small (20 times smaller than the signal) and one would need to provide more details on the reliability.
concerns.summary: The dichroic signal is small relative to the total intensity and needs a percentage magnitude with an error estimate to establish reliability.

concerns.quote: A bit more details on how the elastic was placed would be useful.
concerns.summary: The procedure for locating the elastic line should be described.

concerns.quote: How are the Authors sure that the LSMO was completely removed? LSMO is magnetic (FM) and might induce some magnetism.
concerns.summary: Residual ferromagnetic LSMO from the sacrificial layer could contribute a magnetic signal.
concerns.response: addressed with new data or analysis

concerns.quote: References have some problems with capital letters
concerns.summary: Capitalisation errors in the reference list.

concerns.quote: Figure 1c. There is a typo Pahse should be Phase
concerns.summary: Typo in the Fig. 1c axis label.

concerns.quote: Is the film fully monodomain under the holding potential, or do residual multi-domain states persist? ... Could incomplete switching explain the modest magnitude of the CD signal?
concerns.summary: The domain state under the holding voltage is not characterised, and multi-domain averaging or incomplete switching could reduce the CD and undermine the quantitative comparison with theory.

concerns.quote: The ferroelectric hysteresis loop shown in Fig. 1c appears noticeably asymmetric — the coercive fields for positive and negative switching are unequal
concerns.summary: The asymmetry of the PFM hysteresis loop needs explanation.
concerns.response: addressed with new data or analysis

concerns.quote: The manuscript does not mention whether the non-analytic correction to the dynamical matrix ... was included in the calculations.
concerns.summary: Whether the DFT phonons include LO-TO splitting via the non-analytic correction is not stated, and the full phonon band structure should be shown.
concerns.response: addressed with new data or analysis

concerns.quote: does ferroelectric polarisation reversal necessarily invert the angular momentum of ALL phonon modes across the Brillouin zone, or only those with strong electron-phonon coupling
concerns.summary: Discuss whether all modes reverse chirality on switching or only those strongly coupled to the polar distortion.

concerns.quote: could one use circularly polarised THz or mid-infrared radiation to selectively excite chiral phonon modes and thereby induce or assist ferroelectric polarisation switching?
concerns.summary: Discuss the reciprocal process of driving polarisation switching by exciting one phonon chirality.

concerns.quote: Phonon angular momentum is quantised only when the system possesses continuous rotational symmetry
concerns.summary: The statement that chiral phonons carry quantised angular momentum is inaccurate for a C4v crystal.

concerns.quote: "Realising reversible control of PAM is therefore a critical step toward deterministic manipulation of lattice-driven phenomena governed by chiral symmetries" conflates two distinct concepts.
the handedness (helicity) should be defined as J·e_q, where e_q denotes the direction of q, rather than as J·q.
concerns.summary: Helicity should be defined with the unit vector along q, following prior terminology.

later_concerns.quote: is the energy difference of the two non-degenerate chiralities of the phonon. Can this be extracted from the data using some simulations on the difference spectra?
later_concerns.summary: Optional: estimate the energy splitting between the two phonon chiralities from the difference spectra.

later_concerns.quote: is the 5% of difference between C+ and C- RIXS corresponding to a 5% difference in the chirality populations of the phonons?
later_concerns.summary: Optional: discuss whether the 5% dichroism maps to a population difference of chiral phonons.
Typos and copy-paste errors in main text and SI, including a missing figure reference and Ti3+ that should be Ti4+.

later_concerns.quote: I would suggest a more specific title, for example, 'Electric-field switching of g-wave phonon chirality in ferroelectric BaTiO3'.
